extDescription.message: AI-assisted email replies with OpenRouter or Kimi / Moonshot AI. Message content is sent to your selected provider.

placeholderInstruction.message: e.g. Thank them politely for the offer and accept.

noticeNoBody.message: No readable text part was found in this message (e.g. image-only or encrypted mail).

consentRequired.message: Before replies can be generated, confirm the privacy notice in the settings and store an API key.

privacyBody.message: Reply suggestions and generated replies send the sender, subject, message text and your instruction to the selected Moonshot AI service. When composing, recipients and draft text may be included instead. This can contain personal data of other people. Only use this if you are entitled to share the data. Loading the model list sends the API key but no email content.

consentLabel.message: I consent to sending message content through $PROVIDER$ as described above.

hintApiKey.message: Create a key at $PLATFORM$. It is stored unencrypted in your Thunderbird profile and included in profile backups. “Delete key” removes the key for the selected provider.

hintBaseUrl.message: Requests for this provider go only to $HOSTS$. Keys are never shared between providers.

statusCleared.message: The selected provider’s API key was deleted and consent withdrawn.

errUrlEmpty.message: Please provide an API base URL.

errUrlMalformed.message: The API base URL is not a valid address.

errUrlNotHttps.message: The API base URL must start with https://.

errUrlHostNotAllowed.message: Only api.moonshot.ai, api.moonshot.cn and openrouter.ai are permitted.

errUrlHasCredentials.message: The API base URL must not contain credentials.

errNoConsent.message: The privacy notice has not been confirmed yet. Please consent in the settings.

errNoApiKey.message: Please enter the selected provider’s API key in the settings first.

errNoTab.message: No active tab could be determined.

errTimeout.message: Timeout: the API did not respond within 60 seconds.

errNetwork.message: Network error: the API could not be reached. ($DETAIL$)

errUnauthorized.message: The API key was rejected. Please check it in the settings. ($DETAIL$)

errRateLimited.message: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again. ($DETAIL$)

errEmptyReply.message: The API returned an empty reply.

errHostPermissionMissing.message: Access to $ORIGIN$ has not been granted. Please open the settings and save again; Thunderbird will then ask for the permission.

errPermissionDenied.message: Access to $ORIGIN$ was denied. Grant this permission in the settings to use the provider.

hintModel.message: Type to search the list or enter a model ID. “Load available models” fetches the provider’s catalog; save to keep it. OpenRouter IDs include a provider prefix, such as moonshotai/kimi-k2.5. Availability and prices depend on the model and account.

statusModelsLoaded.message: Loaded $COUNT$ models. Select a model and save settings.

errApiUnavailable.message: This Thunderbird version does not provide the required messageDisplay API. Thunderbird 128 or newer is required.

placeholderComposeInstruction.message: e.g. Ask for a meeting next week, keep the tone factual and brief.

noticeContextOriginal.message: The original message is sent along as context.

noticeContextDraft.message: The current draft text is sent along as context.

noticeContextEmpty.message: The draft is empty — a new email will be written.

errNoComposeTab.message: No compose window could be determined.

suggestManualHint.message: Automatic loading is off. Use “Reload” to request suggestions.

errSuggestUnparsable.message: The model's response contained no usable suggestions. “Reload” tries again.

hintAutoSuggest.message: Creates suggestions on opening the popup for what a reply could cover. Each opening costs one model call — with this off you can still request them via “Reload”.

suggestionsIntro.message: Clicking a topic generates the reply immediately.

firstRunStep1.message: Choose a provider and read its privacy notice.

firstRunStep2.message: Enter that provider’s API key, choose a model and confirm consent.

firstRunStep3.message: Save — Thunderbird may ask for permission to access the selected API.

statusSetupComplete.message: Setup complete. Open an email and click “Reply with AI” in the message view.

privacyOpenRouter.message: Reply suggestions and generated replies send the sender, subject, message text and your instruction to OpenRouter, which forwards the request to the model provider it selects. When composing, recipients and draft text may be included instead. Routing, storage and processing depend on the model and your OpenRouter account settings. Only use this if you are entitled to share the data. Loading the model list sends the API key but no email content.

hintProvider.message: Each provider keeps its own API key, consent and model selection. Save settings to activate your selection.

errUrlEndpoint.message: Select one of the supported API endpoints. Custom paths, ports and query strings are not allowed.

errProviderMismatch.message: The API endpoint does not match the selected provider.

errCredits.message: Insufficient API credit. Check your provider account. ($DETAIL$)

errReplyTruncated.message: The model reached its output limit. No incomplete text was inserted. Try a shorter instruction or another model.

errModelsTimeout.message: The model list request timed out after 20 seconds.
